name: Jolt

source.verification: Tag source archive generated by GitHub for v5.7.0 (tag commit cf16769bb0ede9c45d57d06068ff0689e9702f5c, release 2026-11-14); the release has no assets, so there is no source digest or signature. Every imported file's git blob hash was compared with the tag commit tree. Imported files are LICENSE and the library sources and headers under Jolt/ (.h, .inl, .cpp) except the GPU compute hair simulation (Jolt/Compute/, Jolt/Shaders/, Jolt/Physics/Hair/), the std::thread pool source (Core/JobSystemThreadPool.cpp) and the text object stream sources that Jolt.cmake builds only with ENABLE_OBJECT_STREAM (ObjectStream*.cpp, TypeDeclarations.cpp); tests, samples, viewer, build scripts and docs are not imported.

notes: Rigid body physics middleware for the Physics module (Docs/Design/PhysicsJoltAdapter.ko.md section 10, JL1; EngineImplementationPlan section 16). Rocks <-> Jolt coordinate and unit conversion happens only in the Physics module's private adapter (sections 2-7).

Build definitions (section 10.2): cross-platform deterministic build, single precision positions, asserts in every configuration (JPH_ENABLE_ASSERTS changes struct layouts, so the same definitions reach consumers and VerifyJoltVersionID() checks the feature bits), no debug renderer, no profiler, no floating point exception traps, no GPU compute, custom allocator and temp allocator hooks kept. No SIMD definitions: Jolt selects SSE2 on x64 and NEON on ARM64 from compiler macros because Rocks rejects ISA arguments; the deterministic build disables FMA.

Jolt public headers include STL headers and bring std names into the JPH namespace, so only the Physics module's adapter translation units become a narrow exception to the STL policy (section 10.3). No exceptions and no C++ RTTI (Jolt has its own RTTI).
Global state: JPH::Factory::sInstance, the allocation, Trace and AssertFailed function pointers and RegisterTypes/UnregisterTypes are process wide.

Renderer/ sources are built as in Jolt.cmake and compile out without JPH_DEBUG_RENDERER; ObjectStream/SerializableObject.cpp is required even without JPH_OBJECT_STREAM because it implements the RTTI of SerializableObject.

Differences from the Jolt CMake defaults (built outside CMake): FLOATING_POINT_EXCEPTIONS_ENABLED, ENABLE_OBJECT_STREAM, DEBUG_RENDERER_IN_DEBUG_AND_RELEASE, PROFILER_IN_DEBUG_AND_RELEASE and the USE_SSE4_1..USE_FMADD ISA options are off; JPH_DEBUG (Jolt.cmake defines it for Debug) is defined in no configuration, for the library and consumers alike. Consumers call VerifyJoltVersionID() before RegisterTypes(), which aborts on a feature bit mismatch.

modifications.reason: Add GetAppliedContactImpulse (ContactConstraintManager and the PhysicsSystem forwarder that locks the body with the larger BodyID for its rotation): sums lambda * world contact normal over the manifolds of a body pair from the read contact cache after PhysicsSystem::Update, looked up the same way as WereBodiesInContact. GetContactsFromCache clears the copied impulses of a manifold that gets no constraint in the step (sensor or zero inverse mass scale from the listener, or the constraint buffer is full), as the new manifold path already does, so stale impulses are not reported; this also starts the warm start of such a manifold from zero. Upstream has no public way to read the impulse the solver applied; Rocks hit events report the solver impulse like UE (Docs/Design/PhysicsJoltAdapter.ko.md section 10.6, PhysicsModule section 6.4).
